t: This is Hanover Square, a green square in Mayfair, just south west of Oxford Circus, where Oxford Street meets Regent Street. Six streets converge on it. Several people with a connection to the square were born here. Admiral Sir Henry Harwood commanded the British squadron at the Battle of the River Plate. General Sir Montagu Stopford commanded a corps in Burma, including at Kohima in 1944. Joe Carstairs, known in the 1920s as the fastest woman on water, was born here too. The poet and playwright Lord Lansdowne died here, and so did the architect John Peter Gandy.
